title: Estimates
prompt: Prompt: 50M MAU, each user does ~20 reads/day and 2 writes/day. Candidate says “so about 50M QPS.” What is the right move?

choices.label: Rewrite as ~1e9 reads/day ÷ 86400 ≈ 1e4 QPS order
choices.consequence: MAU≠QPS; daily actions over seconds gives the order.

choices.label: Accept 50M QPS and shard immediately
choices.consequence: You over-design by three orders of magnitude.

choices.label: Skip numbers and draw caches anyway
choices.consequence: Without magnitude you cannot justify the cache.

choices.label: Demand the exact QPS to six decimals
choices.consequence: Interviews want order-of-magnitude, not fake precision.
